chaining: Service accounts have no storage quota and cannot own files; they must upload into shared drives, or use OAuth 2.0 to upload for a human user. identity_cost.detail: Shared drives need a supported Google Workspace edition (Business Standard, Business Plus, Enterprise, Education); personal accounts cannot create them. No sign-up was entered.

extras.document_section: Google Drive and its service-account history
extras.verified_at_basis: checked against the live service on 2026-11-10
extras.quota_verbatim: Service accounts now report storageQuota limit '0' — they cannot own files at all. Real quota comes from the parent tenant: Education/Nonprofit 100 TB pooled, Business Standard 2 TB x users, Business Plus 5 TB x users. The '15 GB per SA x 100 SA x 30 projects = 45 TB' claim in the reference repo is DEAD.
extras.limits_verbatim: SA quota limit = 0 (hard); shared drive 500,000 items / 100 nesting levels; 750 GB/day upload per user; 5 TB max file; Drive API 400,000,000 quota units/day/project before charges and a 1 TB/day egress cap; 1,000,000 units/min/project.
extras.egress_verbatim: No per-GB egress charge for Drive file downloads; drive.usercontent.google.com serves direct bytes. New ceiling: Drive API 1 TB/day per project egress.
extras.chaining_verbatim: The chain inverted. Old: unlimited free SAs x 15 GB each. New: SAs are free and unlimited but hold zero bytes, so they become pure WRITE THROUGHPUT/multiplexer against one tenant's pooled shared drive. 750 GB/day is per acting identity, and each SA is a distinct identity, so N SAs lifting into one shared drive gives N x 750 GB/day ingest; the 100 TB pool is the actual ceiling.
extras.tooling_verbatim: rclone drive backend with service_account_file + shared drive config (rclone docs still document the SA + shared-drive path and warn its shared client_id is being retired during 2026 — make your own). gclone (156 stars, archived), AutoRcloneV2, 88lex/sa-gen (71 stars, last push 2023-05) automate SA creation but not the new shared-drive target.
extras.agent_focus: Google ecosystem: Drive service accounts + shared drives, Colab, Firebase, GCS free tier, Photos. Service-account chain as reference case, quantified.
